global_caption: The video consists of five shots and is a short realistic-style, high-saturation-toned space chemistry experiment. The overall color palette centers on cool blue and high-purity neon hues. Lighting primarily comes from soft illumination by internal instrument panels and clear highlights reflected from the starfield outside the viewport.
shot1: Shot 1 opens with a fade-in, using a wide overhead view to establish the full orbital lab. Curved walls and floating instruments form clear leading lines. In the foreground, a data board floats slowly; in the midground, a fish gently sways its tail fin in microgravity; in the background, a transparent crystallization chamber is fixed at the center of the lab, with slow-moving nebulae visible through the viewport. Under cool dominant lighting, metallic surfaces reflect high-saturation glints. The fish explores around the chamber, adjusting position, conveying quiet tension before the experiment begins. Chinese The camera slowly pushes in from above with a slight downward tilt.
shot2: Shot 2 cuts hard from the previous shot, focusing on a close-up eye-level view of the transparent operation area. Shallow depth of field blurs the background wall, keeping only the seed container and the fish's precise movements in focus. A transparent tube, supersaturated solution syringe, and seed chamber form a clean triangular composition. Stable cool light from internal instruments illuminates the scene, with fine highlights outlining the edge of the seed container. The fish stabilizes its body with slight movements and slowly injects the supersaturated solution into the container. In microgravity, the liquid forms a smooth, floating stream that is precisely guided into the chamber. The camera performs a small lateral pan and gently pushes in to highlight the injection interface.
shot3: Shot 3 transitions via match cut to a macro time-lapse close-up. The shot is a tight eye-level view near the inner wall of the transparent crystallization chamber. Small bubbles occasionally drift across the foreground. The midground shows the seed surface, while the background features dimmed lab light strips. Within the unified cool blue tone, the crystal edges begin to refract high-saturation iridescent highlights. The frame emphasizes the continuous transformation: from clear solution to tiny nuclei, then to uniformly radiating crystal branches. The structure evolves from points and lines into layered, branching 3D formations. The camera remains mostly stable, with only minimal push-in to enhance growth details.
shot4: Shot 4 fades into a medium follow shot, using a slightly upward eye-level angle to convey spatial depth. The transparent crystallization chamber is centered, with the fish circling it, forming a circular motion path. Floating record cards occasionally pass in the foreground. The midground shows the continuously expanding crystal branches, while the background features moving nebula light bands outside the viewport. Lighting remains dominated by soft internal lights and crystal-reflected highlights. The fish adjusts its swimming speed while observing, and the crystal branches continue to extend outward, becoming sharper in outline. The camera smoothly pans around the fish’s trajectory with slight pitch adjustments.
shot5: Shot 5 cuts hard from the previous shot, followed by a brief pause. It uses a wide static eye-level composition. The mature crystal chamber is positioned at the golden ratio point. In the foreground, a softly blurred control panel light appears. The midground features a complete, clearly layered transparent mature crystal. In the background, through the viewport, a high-saturation nebula slowly expands, framing the experimental result against the cosmic backdrop. Lighting remains clear and cool, creating delicate bright edges on the crystal. The fish hovers quietly on one side, no longer operating. The image clearly conveys the stable state of completed experimentation. The camera performs a very slight pull-out, placing the crystal, fish, and nebula into a complete closing composition.
